fundamental_news.headline: Intuitive Machines Q1 2026 Earnings Transcript
fundamental_news.summary: Intuitive Machines reported Q1 2026 revenue of $186.7 million, representing approximately 3x growth compared to Q1 2025, excluding $13 million from 12 days of Lanteris revenue post-acquisition close. Gross profit was $30.1 million, a significant increase from $6.7 million in Q1 2025, driven by higher-margin service contributions and satellite business performance. Adjusted EBITDA was positive $2.7 million, compared to negative $6.6 million in Q1 2025, attributed primarily to higher-margin Lanteris contributions. Operating loss was $39.2 million, compared to $10.1 million in Q1 2025, with the increase driven by acquisition-related costs, amortization, and investment in satellite capabilities. SG&A expense was $50.7 million, including $20 million in acquisition and integration costs and $6.3 million for share-based compensation tied to the Lanteris acquisition; these costs are described as largely nonrecurring.
fundamental_news.why_it_matters: The strong revenue growth and improved profitability metrics, despite increased operating expenses due to strategic acquisitions, suggest that Intuitive Machines is effectively scaling its operations, reinforcing its competitive position and supporting a positive long-term investment thesis.

fundamental_news.headline: Intuitive Machines guides $900M-$1B 2026 revenue
fundamental_news.summary: Intuitive Machines reported Q4 and full-year 2025 results on March 19, 2026, highlighting operational expansion and major transactions. Strategic moves include completing KinetX acquisition, completing an $800M Lanteris acquisition in Q1 2026, launching EchoStar XXV, a $175M strategic investment, and participation on large national security IDIQs.
fundamental_news.why_it_matters: The positive revenue guidance and strategic acquisitions indicate a strong growth trajectory, enhancing Intuitive Machines' competitive position and supporting a positive long-term investment thesis.
